conservative_estimate.training_assumption: For each policy family, extrapolate its measured 95th percentile training seconds per step to 500 steps for every one of 400 episodes; five seed jobs run concurrently per policy.
conservative_estimate.evaluation_assumption: Every periodic, final, and shift evaluation episode reaches the 500-step cap; five seed jobs run concurrently per policy.
conservative_estimate.decision: Keep 5 seeds and 400 episodes; estimate is below the 90-minute wall budget.
